title: lint: unify golangci-lint config and clear common/image/storage backlog
body:
Today each of common, image, and storage carried its own golangci-lint config. This PR replaces that with a single root `.golangci.yml` (with `relative-path-mode: gitroot`) and points Make/CI at it. With one policy in place, the rest of the PR clears the backlog that showed up under it: wrapping errors with `%w`, checking type assertions, renaming locals that shadowed predeclared names, and a handful of smaller cleanups (HTTP status constants, misspell, etc.). Where we cannot rename things without breaking public or ABI-facing names, we carve them out narrowly. For example ST1005 under image/, the `copy` package paths, storage ST1003, and intentional value/pointer Marshal receivers.

## Behavior
This is meant to be a lint cleanup, not a feature change. There are no public API signature changes.
A few places do change runtime details in small ways:
- The image storage destination now passes the caller's `context` through layer commit / DiffID helpers instead of `context.Background()`.
- Dual-error paths use `errors.Join`, so both errors stay in the chain for `errors.Is` / unwrap.
- Type assertions that used to panic on an impossible type now fail more gently (return an error or `false`).

Normal Linux/Unix happy paths should behave the same.

Fixes: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/issues/1358
